newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ says upgrade helps positioning.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ says upgrade helps positioning.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) said on Tuesday the positioning of its debt issues in offshore and domestic capital markets had been enhanced by today's ratings upgrade by agency Standard & Poor's.

"In terms of issues obviously it's positive. Being a double-A bank has got quite important positioning benefits ... both offshore and domestically, particularly offshore," general manager investor relations David Ward told Reuters.
Standard & Poor's Corp earlier announced it had upgraded the long and short term counterparty credit ratings of ANZ.
ANZ's short term rating was raised to AA minus from A plus and its short term rating to A1 plus from A1.
Ward declined to comment on specific savings ANZ might make on domestic or offshore issues on the back of their new ratings.
"It's (the upgrade) really a more generic comment rather than something you an put basis points on," he said.
ANZ shares closed nine cents higher at A$6.62.
